reasoning.because: The fullest real copy could not be read inside 20s on Facebook feed video.
It would run past 20s, the most Facebook feed video holds attention for; the end card still names the product.
Most of this audience never unmutes, so nothing depends on sound; cues are kept quieter and sparser for those who do.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on Facebook feed video (0.32s a word), inside 8–20s.
